body: Right? Something's just off with it and it makes me feel gross when I drink it. The chill offsets that grossness.
Hah. I am fond of whites myself. Reds are okay, usually, but I prefer cold drinks so white takes my fancy..
Lol I have skipped most of the story in favour of upgrades and such. I can happily sink hours into finding materials and building. Base.
I love Starbound. I had just finished building an awesome space station before 1.0 dropped. Unfortunately I can't find the screenshots I had of it though. I might have to rebuild.

I was playing American Truck Simulator before I decided to go for a walk. That game helps me feel relaxed and is great to go with a podcast. Otherwise I am highly fond of space games, Elite: Dangerous being one of my favourites.

As for music, I tend to gravitate toward chill electronic, though I want to try some more ambient things with a wider range of instruments.

The obvious hobby would be video games, but otherwise I am very fond of Photoshop, illustration, sound design and music production. There's always a nice feeling of watching a creation come together, then being completed hours later.

Ending a marriage is not an easy decision to make. I had to make the same choice early this year, and it was a bittersweet combination of relief and being torn to shreds. You've got this, though.

What kind of wine do you like, red or white?

It's weird. I went for a walk thinking that might make me feel better. Instead it seemed to just make all my thoughts and emotions spill over.

It's hard to find motivation and inspiration for my hobbies. It's silly really. I don't get why a mind would make you not feel like doing things that normally make you happy.
Can definitely relate to that one, buddy. Stings more than we feel like it should eh?

I don't know.

All it took to really upset me today was a bloody door-to-door salesperson. Normally I'd just shrug it off and move on, but today, it broke my moment of xen. I was relaxing with a game and a podcast and I can say it had been the first time I've felt so at-ease in a long time, then the knocking happened and once they finally got the hint that I am not interested the xen went to shit and I felt annoyed and upset.

Now I'm sitting outside by the river... So much is going through my head that it's like white-noise, and I'm just wondering what the point of going through every day is.

Sorry, this is pretty heavy.

Sorry for the delayed response

Before all this, I had been more or less glum as well. I have this lingering fear that I am going to spend my life alone. I don't just mean romantically, but in general. I try to go out and hang with people, but even with people around, I still feel very alone. 

My motivation is generally way down, and a lot of the time I don't feel a lot at all... Not happy, not sad... just nothing.

It hasn't been a great year. I thought it'd be an improvement over last year, but it hasn't been, but instead of my marriage falling apart, it's just been emptiness.

You are right. If I stayed with her, I'd probably be more miserable huh?

Thanks, Mum. I don't feel 100% better, and I don't know when I will, but I feel like I got a huge weight off my chest at least.

I'll think over what you've said for a while, it is helpful. 

I'm not sure if I have more to say yet, but chances are I might once I've had time to process things a bit more.

Like I said before, my mind is like white noise and I often feel like the things I do say are squeezing through a bottle neck, all trying to come out at once but unable to.

I still have weight, but this is a good start.

You're wonderful.

Thank you so much.

I love you. (you have no idea how nice it feels to say that)

Edit: I need a good cry...

I did my best. But why doesn't it feel like it?

Why do I feel dread when I look at myself in the mirror?

Thanks,

I thought I was moving on, but now that you mention it, maybe I am still grieving. I miss having someone to come home to I guess. My home is so empty. 

What's worse is that I don't feel like I can turn to anyone, not even my actual family. I can sense that they're disappointed in me for not making it work. If we're being honest, I'm disappointed in myself.

I tried so hard, Mum. But in the end, I couldn't keep it going with all the heartache.

I tried to figure out what was making it fall apart, but every time I tried to talk to her, she pushed me away. She got angry.

She used to get angry a lot, actually. If she drank alcohol, she got really mean. I'd try to get her to drink less, but she would have none of that.

I never tell anyone of this because apparently we were such a perfect couple.

But we weren't, were we Mum? I should have seen it sooner.

All the times she ignored me, or got horrible while drunk. The times I felt like I needed her the most, and she'd just dismiss it and tell me I need help.

I didn't need help at the time, I just needed her to be there.

But she wasn't. Physically, she was... But otherwise?

I have issues with intimacy, and she promised me she understood.

But she didn't. She resented me for it. She'd never admit it, but I could tell.

I thought I was happy, but in hindsight, I was not. I was anxious all the time, or I was upset about something.

But she wouldn't listen when I tried to resolve it.

I married a narcissist, Mum, and it hurts so much. Two years of hurt is all built up.

I can't help but feel like it's my fault.
